title: Create HeroSection Component
description: Develop a new, reusable HeroSection React component for the landing page.
details:
Create a new file at components/hero-section.tsx. Implement the HeroSection component using semantic HTML elements (
,

,

). Style the component with Tailwind CSS utility classes to ensure responsiveness and visual appeal. Use props to allow easy configuration of the headline, sub-headline, and CTA label. Import the Button component from components/ui/button.tsx for the CTA. Ensure accessibility by using proper heading levels and ARIA attributes as needed.
test_strategy: Manually verify the component renders correctly with various prop values. Check for accessibility (keyboard navigation, screen reader labels). Run a basic render test using React Testing Library to ensure the component mounts without errors.

title: Integrate HeroSection into Landing Page
description: Import and render the HeroSection component at the top of the main landing page (app/page.tsx).
details: Open app/page.tsx and import the newly created HeroSection component. Place it at the top of the main content structure, above other sections. Pass appropriate props for the headline, sub-headline, and CTA label. Ensure the CTA button links to '/sign-up' using Next.js <Link> for client-side navigation.
test_strategy: Manually verify that the hero section appears at the top of the landing page and the CTA button navigates to '/sign-up'. Confirm that the integration does not break existing sections or layout.

title: Ensure Responsiveness and Visual Consistency
description: Test and refine the HeroSection to ensure it is fully responsive and visually consistent with the rest of the site.
details: Use browser dev tools to test the HeroSection across major breakpoints (mobile, tablet, desktop). Adjust Tailwind CSS classes as needed for padding, font sizes, and layout. Ensure the design aligns with the shadcn/ui component library and the overall site theme (including dark mode compatibility).
test_strategy: Manually resize the browser window and use device emulation to check layout and appearance. Compare with design guidelines and other UI components for consistency.

title: Validate Accessibility and CTA Functionality
description: Verify that the HeroSection meets accessibility standards and that the CTA button functions correctly.
details: Check that the main headline uses an <h1> tag, the CTA button is keyboard-navigable, and all interactive elements have descriptive labels. Use accessibility tools (e.g., Lighthouse, axe) to audit the section. Confirm that the CTA button's href points to '/sign-up' and navigates as expected.
test_strategy: Run accessibility audits using browser extensions. Manually tab through the section to ensure keyboard accessibility. Test the CTA button's navigation in the browser.
